messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: XrYxkU-4s8--jwEOEsxjAg

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "XrYxkU-4s8--jwEOEsxjAg"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",

    "guards",

  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",

  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

parsed.title: The Mirror Road Through the Ruined City

scenes.caption: Mara unfolds her map at the broken city's edge.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept overlook above a ruined royal city at dusk, tattered banners flapping on distant spires. A coated figure kneels with a brass compass over a hand-drawn map weighted by stones.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of obvious traps ahead.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of a brass oil lamp held aloft, a single eye burning inside its flame, casting a long worried shadow across cracked cobblestones and a crumbling gate.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts the rubble-strewn approach.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with a key-wind tail and blue glass eyes darts between fallen statues, gears clicking softly under a violet twilight sky.

scenes.caption: The Glass Diver arrives by stepping out of a shop window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a tall cracked storefront window as if surfacing from water, coat shimmering with reflected city lights.

scenes.caption: They debate which temptation to ignore first.
scenes.visual_description: Four companions huddled in an alley, the lamp's eye throwing light on a map dotted with castle gates, a cursed tower, and rumored lair markings.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol stomps past, missing them.
scenes.visual_description: From a low gutter view, polished boots and pike-butts thud by overhead while a clockwork fox crouches flat behind a barrel, blue eyes dimmed.

scenes.caption: The cursed tower beckons with false treasure-light.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning black tower glows green from slit windows; floating coins and crowns drift in the air outside it. The lamp's eye narrows in disapproval.

scenes.caption: Mara redraws the route to avoid the tower entirely.
scenes.visual_description: Ink bleeding across vellum as a gloved hand draws a new red line skirting wide around the tower, brass compass spinning beside a steaming tin cup.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector slumped in a kiosk.
scenes.visual_description: A toll booth full of stamped papers, an official snoring with a ledger as a pillow, official seals stuck comically to his sleeves and cheek.

scenes.caption: The lamp warns: do not wake him, do not pay him.
scenes.visual_description: The oracle lamp tilts close to the sleeper's ear, its flame-eye wide with alarm; Mara holds a coin back at arm's length.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips through a tall stained-glass door.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a diving helmet wades shoulder-deep into a glowing cathedral window as if it were water, ripples spreading across colored glass saints.

scenes.caption: On the other side: a locked magic door pulses red.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a vaulted hall, a heavy iron door glows with rotating sigils; the diver's reflection multiplies across its polished surface.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox picks the lock with a wound-up tail.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up: a clockwork fox jams its slim copper key-tail into a glowing keyhole, sparks dancing along its whiskers.

scenes.caption: They find the captive curled in a chalk circle.
scenes.visual_description: A dim cell with a chalk binding circle on the floor; the sleeping tax collector is dragged in, blinking, while Mara kneels to break the chalk line.

scenes.caption: An alarm horn sounds across the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: Through a shattered window, distant towers light up one by one with red beacons; banners snap in a sudden wind as the lamp's eye flares.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox leads them through mirrored back-alleys.
scenes.visual_description: Narrow lanes lined with hanging mirror shards reflect the running party into a hundred copies; the fox sprints ahead, tail whirring.

scenes.caption: They sprint onto the long bridge out of the city.
scenes.visual_description: A vast moonlit stone bridge over a black river, the broken skyline behind them; four companions and a half-awake official pelt across cracked flagstones.

scenes.caption: Beyond the bridge, Mara marks the route as closed.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn over rolling hills; the cartographer stamps a red X across the city on her map while the lamp dims to a soft ember and the fox folds neatly into sleep.
